## HAPI v0.27.2.1

### Compared with the previous maintained release

Rebuilt from current `upstream/main` (00b6e448) with the maintained distribution overlay and carries. New carries: provider profiles and managed-provider model routing (#1091), notification center with push/FCM/Telegram delivery and model-error notification (#987), searchable session picker on Android share target (#986), and Codex agent-budget UX (#847). Also carries session-attached jobs (#1424), fleet runner version governance (#1108), per-queued-message steer (#906), project-group context menu (#955), and the Cursor soft-steer / ACP error-classification fixes.

### Compared with the official release

Same maintained overlay as `v0.26.0.2` plus the carries above, rebuilt on `upstream/main` 00b6e448 (project-pin groups #1432, session jobs #1404, media display #1405, and everything up to official `0.27.2`). Desktop launcher packaging (#769) is included and gated behind the maintained release flow.

### Maintained-fork guarantees

Release tags are published only from commits contained in `main`; macOS artifacts retain the `xyz.hapi.cli` signing identity; app-shell cache headers remain no-store. GitHub auto-generated release notes are never published — the curated notes in this file are used instead.
